description: New bounded context, once docs/<context>/domain-model.md exists: the three projects src/<Context>.Domain (referencing Bank.Kernel), src/<Context>.Application and src/<Context>.Infrastructure with its Add<Context>() registration, the three entries in Bank.slnx, the project references and the Add<Context>() and Map<Context>Endpoints() calls in Bank.Api, plus the empty endpoint group src/Bank.Api/<Context>/<Context>Endpoints.cs and its <Context>.http. Run it before hex-driven-port, hex-use-case and hex-endpoint for that context.
